In no event shall the board fail to 17 issue a final decision on an application within seventy-five 18 calendar days of receipt of all necessary documentation from 19 the applicant or the applicant’s designee. 20 EXPLANATION 21 The inclusion of this explanation does not constitute agreement with 22 the explanation’s substance by the members of the general assembly. 23 This bill relates to licenses to practice medicine and 24 surgery or osteopathic medicine and surgery, and administrative 25 medicine licenses (license). The bill allows an applicant for 26 a license to designate a person to submit application materials 27 on the applicant’s behalf. The bill requires the board of 28 medicine (board) to adopt rules setting the term of a license 29 at not less than three years, and requires a license to expire 30 on the birthday of a licensee.
